items.source:
Get the number of matching elements.
This method uses an aggregation execution even for empty queries which may have an impact on performance, but guarantees shard, session and transaction compliance. In case an inaccurate count satisfies the applications needs use ReactiveMongoOperations.estimatedCount(String) for empty queries instead.
items.translation:
获取匹配元素的数量。
此方法即使对于空的queries也会使用aggregation execution，这可能会影响性能，但能保证分片、会话和事务的合规性。如果应用程序的需求可以通过不准确的计数来满足，则对于空查询请使用ReactiveMongoOperations.estimatedCount(String)。

items.source: Compose find execution by calling one of the terminating methods.
items.translation: 通过调用其中一个终止方法来触发查找执行。

items.source: Get the number of matching elements.
Mono emitting total number of matching elements. Never null.
items.translation: Mono 发出匹配元素的总数。永不返回 null。

items.source: Mono emitting true if at least one matching element exists. Never null.
items.translation: Mono 在存在至少一个匹配元素时发射 true，且永远不会为 null。

items.source: Mark Paluch, Christoph Strobl, Juergen Zimmermann
